description:
## Approved plan task V1

- Review boundary leakage across all edited seams, especially BO→Channels→Engine, opaque transport metadata, configuration scope and privilege propagation.
- Run isolated affected tests and `mix q` per implementation issue. Run existing relevant browser coverage during development; new consolidated E2E follows B3 approval.
- After implementation and PR review approval, perform the workflow-required coverage handoff; use current coverage tooling and record exceptions rather than imposing per-task numeric gates.
- Run final `mix precommit` per the authoritative workflow before requesting final approval. Resolve failures, and repeat only when changes/failures justify it.
- Record commands/results and remaining external-widget integration work.
- Commit, push and merge remain separately authorized actions.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write the specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.
